title: Missing permission set: guide walk_* MCP tools prompt on every state op

title: Claude Code plugin catalog/marketplace submission readiness
description:
## Motivation

The agentguides launch plan promises Claude Code plugin-catalog distribution (Phase 3b, /Users/brian/workspace/github/agentguides/infra/.plans/launch-plan-2026-06-20.md: "Claude Code plugin distribution. Publish to Claude Code's plugin catalog."), and ag-infra-n4o (agentguides/infra, P2, "Package + submit Claude Code plugin") tracks the actual submission — but nothing on the plugin side defines the mechanics. Today distribution is git-clone of a validated tagged tree (README.md Install section) plus a self-hosted marketplace manifest in the spec repo (agentguides/agentguides/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json, currently pinning guide at ref v0.1.1).

The plugin is deliberately thin/declarative (.claude-plugin/plugin.json v0.1.1; MCP registration via .mcp.json; walk Skill triple; observer audit hooks). The skills are derived artifacts re-rendered from the runtime with a zero-diff invariant (justfile `build` runs `just render` + `git diff --exit-code -- skills`). The dev harness pins agentguides>=0.5.10,<0.6.0 (pyproject.toml), and the coming spec-v0.2 / v0.6 parallelism bumps will force plugin releases — so versioning/tagging discipline tied to runtime pins is on the critical path for any catalog listing.

## Proposed approach

Design-first scoping epic. Produce the plugin-side definitions ag-infra-n4o depends on: (1) verify current Claude Code marketplace/catalog requirements against official docs, (2) gap-analyze plugin.json + marketplace.json against them, (3) codify versioning + tagging discipline tied to runtime pins, (4) a release checklist wired to the zero-diff render invariant and `verify-runtime`, (5) install-path verification for the catalog flow vs git-clone.

## Scope / non-goals

- NOT the actual submission — that is ag-infra-n4o (agentguides/infra); this epic is the plugin-side scoping it depends on.
- NOT CI standup — ag-run-4n92 (agentguides/runtime, cross-repo compat CI epic) has a .3 child that stands up this repo's baseline CI; release checks here should build on that, not duplicate it. Coordination notes only.
- No code or doc changes land from this epic beyond design/checklist artifacts scoped by the children.

## Acceptance criteria

- Catalog/marketplace requirements verified against current official Claude Code docs and recorded (not assumed from memory).
- Manifest gap analysis complete: required changes to plugin.json and agentguides/agentguides marketplace.json enumerated.
- Versioning + tagging policy documented, explicitly tied to the agentguides runtime pin range and the spec-v0.2 / v0.6 bump path.
- Release checklist exists, wired to `just build` (zero-diff render) + `just verify-runtime`, with an explicit note on what defers to ag-run-4n92.3 CI.
- Install-path verification procedure defined for marketplace install vs git-clone install parity.

## Open questions

- Catalog requirements may have changed: is there an official Anthropic-curated catalog with a submission process, or only self-hosted marketplaces (`/plugin marketplace add`)? Needs verification against current Claude Code plugin-marketplace docs — flagged as the research child.
- Does the marketplace `ref` pin (currently v0.1.1) need automation on `just bump`, or stay a manual follow-up?
